service.name: Wakayama City Wagamachi Guide
service.access: Anonymous public guest access; no login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe property fields used.

attempts.outcome: HTTP success; live JavaScript configuration was inspected.
attempts.evidence: Map catalog included roads, sewer service areas, city-planning map (MapId 11015), white map, regulatory areas, landscape, ponds, designated roads, backgrounds, and aerial imagery. No parcel/cadastral layer was listed.

attempts.route: Official map agreement and map shell
attempts.outcome: Anonymous agreement returned an empty successful JSON result; map shell returned HTTP success.
attempts.schemaCrs: The live config reported PROJECT_EPSG EPSG:4326 for geographic display, with Japanese local definitions EPSG:2448/EPSG:30166 and WGS84/JGD2000 conversion parameters. The map's SearchCoord entry used EPSG:2448_EPSG:30166.
attempts.outcomeDetail: The exposed endpoints are generic map/feature tools for the selected city-planning map. No parcel layer, safe native parcel identity, or parcel geometry response was available from the inspected public configuration.

attempts.outcome: Local cadastral-survey and Legal Affairs Bureau map-making responsibilities/procedures were evidenced. City map sales page links the public portal but describes city base/planning maps, not a downloadable parcel service.

scopeLimits: The city portal catalog was checked as currently served on 2026-10-11; absence of a parcel layer there is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No exact-point parcel hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was used as an absence claim.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No parcel polygon was retained because no safe native parcel ID plus unchanged native geometry was obtained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity only if directly exposed and safe
native parcel polygon geometry only if directly exposed and bounded
source URL, layer/map identifier, CRS, response status, and field mapping metadata

qualification.uncertainty: The official city and legal-affairs sources establish local cadastral/map custodians and current map-making activity, but do not expose a public anonymous parcel polygon API in the inspected route.
